trigger: User asks what 20-minute cap does, whether top conferences already provide useful data, and whether this detour advances experiments.

observed_execution.purpose: cross-site source geometry leakage screening, not training or model inference
observed_execution.budget_origin: executor-selected finite CPU stage budget, not a paper requirement

assessment: Initial runtime and loader work provided necessary capabilities. Continuing Swiss whole-corpus deduplication before established-scene baselines has low immediate value for the paired professional-reason/action hypothesis and is deferred.

verified_sources.name: 3D-FRONT
verified_sources.evidence: 18,968 furnished rooms; professionally sourced layouts with curated style-compatible assets.
verified_sources.limit: No verified original occupant brief or per-decision designer rationale. Original project data and model licenses/download routes still require checking; no new files downloaded this turn.

verified_sources.name: InstructScene
verified_sources.evidence: 3D-FRONT scene-instruction pairs; spatial rules, BLIP captions and ChatGPT refinement.
verified_sources.role: instruction-to-layout baseline and explicitly synthetic supervision
verified_sources.limit: Instructions derived from scene relations are not original real-project reasons. Same source family as 3D-FRONT, not an independent corpus. Dataset card CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; inherited asset conditions must remain visible.

verified_sources.name: HSSD
verified_sources.evidence: 211 human-authored 3D scenes,18,656 object models; project page states CC-BY-NC4.0.
verified_sources.role: first check for reusable furnished-room geometry using existing authorized asset path
verified_sources.limit: Existing asset access does not establish full scenes locally imported or independent from base-model training. No original resident reasons or our-output expert approval established.

verified_sources.name: Scene-Designer
verified_sources.evidence: Public resource table lists Scene-Builder SFT and Scene-OTC-Bench (94 pair comparisons,55 four-scene rankings). OTA35K/OTC15K are described; README release table alone is not evidence of downloadable full training data.
verified_sources.role: existing tool/action format and separate critic evaluation
verified_sources.limit: Official held-out benchmark must not enter training; critic evaluation does not replace whole-room construction evaluation.

verified_sources.name: RenoLayout
verified_sources.evidence: Appendix A states proprietary training data cannot be released;200-case benchmark planned via OpenReview. Design points are inferred from before/after differences with VLM verification.
verified_sources.role: closest before/after residential design method/reference; access remains unverified
verified_sources.limit: Not an already downloaded public professional-decision training corpus; inferred design points are not original designer rationale.

decisions: Defer Swiss full-corpus grouping and source extraction. Preserve v1/v2 failure and completed artifacts; no v3.

Prioritize actual availability of established furnished scenes and instruction data, then a fixed cross-room generation baseline with frozen project split and budget. Do not redownload assets already present.
Separate usable scene/action/instruction evidence from the extra same-project professional rationale needed to test the core hypothesis; missing the latter must not block every baseline.

Existing protocol allows sourced author explanations and explicitly reconstructed actions. Independent professional review is required for aesthetic/comfort/preference claims and final whole-room human evaluation, not automatically for every factual source record or engineering baseline.

Keep core paired-versus-separated professional-data hypothesis. Synthetic reasons may support a separately labelled baseline but cannot silently replace professional evidence. Training still needs separate authorization.
next_deliverable: Close the source-to-scene/object/action/consequence chain for Bukit movable seating and Geneva functional grouping; then apply the same evidence extraction rules to the already indexed project corpus. No change of research question to generic scene generation.
priority_clarification: Established datasets support baselines/resources. Source-grounded professional decision records remain the primary bottleneck; HSSD acquisition is not the first scientific milestone.
